SXT should remain in the universe as an underfollowed color/flavor/personal-care/pharma-nutraceutical input supplier with potential formulation and regulatory lock-in; verify segment-level pricing power and exposure to synthetic-color regulation.

Formulation-critical consumer inputs may be misclassified as chemicals or ingredients even when demand is driven by beauty, home care, nutrition, supplement, OTC, and private-label consumer products.
